title: Beyond Data Quantity: Key Factors Driving Performance in Multilingual Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities of multilingual language models across 204 languages on classification (SIB-200) and machine translation (Flores-200) tasks, using regression models and SHAP values to measure how features like pre-train data availability, token similarity, resource levels, and geographic/cultural proximity impact performance for underrepresented languages.
